subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the dragonborn general who grappled the Pudding King after teleporting and flying into the throne room, successfully isolating him from his allies.
source_quote: Zalthir manifested his tentacles, was hurled thirty feet by the Earth Elemental, teleported sixty feet closer, walked forty-five feet, and wrapped his tentacles around the Pudding King.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King is a gnomish villain allied with Juiblex, who sought to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by consuming its people, and transformed into an amorphous ooze form when grappled by Zalthir.
source_quote: The Pudding King gloated about consuming Blingdenstone’s army, ranted about Zuggtmoy, and transformed into a shifting mass when grappled, but Zalthir maintained his grip and dragged him fifteen feet south.

subject: Dasco Pickshine
fact: Dasco Pickshine is the owner of Pickshine Mines who obsessively promoted his brand, sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz’s clothing, and offered his miners to build a mithral-and-salt bridge over a black pudding pit, knowing they would be left behind to maintain it.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine personally sewed a patch onto Daz’s clothes, offered mithral braces and salt neutralizers to bridge the pit, and explained his miners would have to stay behind to maintain it against acid.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin is the leader of the wererats who emphasized his pack’s stealth, scouted ahead with his team, and offered to howl at a frequency to drown out psychic slime effects, knowing it would draw all the oozes to attack his wererats.
source_quote: Chipgrin offered to howl at a frequency to drown out the psychic song of the gelatinous slime mirrors, but admitted it would draw all the oozes to attack his wererats, leaving the party without scouts.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a lieutenant under Zalthir who realized Jimjar’s bet about Thorin crossing the gap was ambiguous and persuaded Thorin to walk across the bridge instead of jumping.
source_quote: Grygum realized Jimjar hadn’t specified how Thorin should cross and persuaded him that walking across the bridge would be just as satisfying.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who considered jumping over a black pudding pit but, after dialogue with his sentient sword Dawnbringer, agreed to walk across the bridge built by Pickshine Miners to avoid getting stuck in acid.
source_quote: Thorin considered jumping, but Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid, so Thorin agreed walking across the bridge was just as satisfying.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is Thorin’s sentient sword that argued against jumping into acid, persuading Thorin to walk across the mithral bridge instead.
source_quote: Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid, leading Thorin to agree walking across the bridge was just as satisfying.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an intelligent ooze allied with the party who promised he would never hurt his friends but recalled hearing a voice from a pool of slimes, suggesting the Pudding King may influence him.
source_quote: Glabbagool promised he would never hurt his friends but recalled hearing a voice from a large pool of slimes, suggesting the Pudding King might have influence over him.

subject: Earth Elemental
fact: The Earth Elemental is an ally who smashed through the ochre jelly barricade and hurled Zalthir into the throne room, unaffected by acid and capable of breaching the Pudding King’s defenses.
source_quote: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly and hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room, unaffected by acid.

subject: Princess Ebonheir
fact: Princess Ebonheir is one of the Pudding King’s two ooze henchmen, present in the throne room as he monologued about consuming Blingdenstone and his alliance with Juiblex.
source_quote: Princess Ebonheir stood beside Prince Livid as the Pudding King gloated about consuming Blingdenstone’s army and claimed Juiblex had promised him the kingdom.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid is one of the Pudding King’s two ooze henchmen, present in the throne room as he ranted about Zuggtmoy and his alliance with Juiblex.
source_quote: Prince Livid stood beside Princess Ebonheir as the Pudding King ranted that Zuggtmoy thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: Pickshine Miners
fact: The Pickshine Miners are a team led by Dasco Pickshine who built a mithral-and-salt bridge over a black pudding pit in twenty minutes while singing, knowing they would remain behind to maintain it against acid.
source_quote: The Pickshine Miners completed the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs, knowing they would stay behind to maintain it against acid.

subject: Wererats
fact: The wererats, led by Chipgrin, served as stealth scouts for the party, investigated a missing scout, and offered to howl to disrupt psychic slime effects at the cost of drawing all oozes to attack them.
source_quote: The wererats scouted ahead, found their scout caught in gelatinous slime mirrors, and offered to howl to drown out the psychic song — knowing it would draw all the oozes to attack them.

subject: Black Pudding
fact: A twenty-foot stretch of passageway was hollowed into a pulsating pit of black pudding with an acid-dripping ceiling, which the Pickshine Miners bridged with mithral and salt.
source_quote: A twenty-foot stretch of passageway had been hollowed out into a pulsating pit of black pudding, with an acid-dripping ceiling above.

subject: Gelatinous Slime Mirrors
fact: Tunnel walls transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects, emitting a rhythmic wet clicking and singing a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.
source_quote: The tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects. A 'brain slime' in the ceiling emitted a rhythmic, wet clicking and sang a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.

subject: Ochre Jelly
fact: A massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly barred a grand vaulted corridor, pulsing with the Pudding King’s heartbeat, with pseudopods attempting to pull intruders into its acidic mass.
source_quote: A grand vaulted corridor was barred by a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly. The creature filled the hallway from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum that matched the Pudding King's own heartbeat.

subject: Green Slime
fact: Green slime patches covered the ceiling of the Pudding King’s throne room, capable of dropping on anyone standing beneath them.
source_quote: Green slime patches on the ceiling throughout the throne room could drop on anyone standing beneath them.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a community under threat from the Pudding King’s campaign to convert its biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume its people.
source_quote: The Pudding King was trying to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.

subject: Pudding King's Court
fact: The Pudding King's court is the throne room where he monologued to his henchmen, guarded by green slime on the ceiling and blocked by an ochre jelly barrier.
source_quote: The Pudding King monologued to Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid in his throne room, with green slime patches on the ceiling and an ochre jelly barrier blocking entry.

subject: Area Twenty-Two
fact: Area Twenty-Two is the designated reserve position where the party’s allies waited while the wererats scouted ahead.
source_quote: The other allies waited in reserve at area twenty-two while the wererats scouted ahead.

subject: Bridge Construction
fact: The Pickshine Miners constructed a mithral-and-salt bridge over a black pudding pit in twenty minutes while singing, knowing they would remain behind to maintain it against acid.
source_quote: The Pickshine Miners completed the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs, knowing they would stay behind to maintain it against acid.

subject: Ochre Jelly Breach
fact: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade and hurled Zalthir into the throne room, allowing the party to engage the Pudding King directly.
source_quote: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade and hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.

subject: Pudding King Grapple
fact: Zalthir successfully grappled the Pudding King, dragged him fifteen feet south away from his allies, and isolated him in a desperate confrontation despite the villain’s transformation into an amorphous ooze form.
source_quote: Zalthir struck the Pudding King and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him, then dragged him fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.

subject: Pudding King's Origin
fact: The Pudding King’s connection to Juiblex and his possible influence over Glabbagool and other oozes suggests deeper ties to the demon lord that remain unexplored.
source_quote: Glabbagool recalled hearing a voice from a pool of slimes, suggesting the Pudding King might have influence over him, and the party learned he had made an alliance with Juiblex.

subject: Fate of the Second Wererat Scout
fact: The second wererat scout vanished after venturing into gelatinous slime mirrors, and its fate remains unknown despite Chipgrin’s investigation.
source_quote: The second wererat scout ventured further ahead but didn't return. Chipgrin found the first scout terrified but the second one was missing.

subject: Plan for the Captured Pudding King
fact: The party has not established a clear plan for what to do with the Pudding King once captured, beyond the initial snatch-and-grab objective.
source_quote: They debated what to do with the King once captured, realizing they hadn't established a clear plan beyond the initial snatch-and-grab.

subject: Dasco Pickshine Patch
fact: A Dasco Pickshine patch was personally sewn onto Daz’s clothing by Dasco Pickshine as a promotional gesture for his mining brand.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes, standing proudly beside the much taller dragonborn.

subject: Mithral Braces
fact: Mithral braces were used by the Pickshine Miners to bridge the black pudding pit, allowing the party to cross safely while the miners stayed behind to maintain the structure.
source_quote: His miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.

subject: Salt Neutralizers
fact: Salt neutralizers were used alongside mithral braces by the Pickshine Miners to counteract the corrosive effects of the black pudding pit.
source_quote: His miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.

subject: Twenty Minutes
fact: The Pickshine Miners completed the bridge over the black pudding pit in twenty minutes while singing.
source_quote: The Pickshine Miners completed the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.

subject: Ten Minutes
fact: Ten anxious minutes passed before Chipgrin went to investigate the missing second wererat scout.
source_quote: After ten anxious minutes, Chipgrin went to investigate and found the scout caught and terrified.
